name: mashira-stage-tournament
reviewNotes: All 49 original glyph records reviewed, including Mashira's long parody biography and breakdown, tournament instructions and dynamic result fields.

Preserve original fictional/parody dates 1940/1962/1964/1965, 50 ryo admission, 100 points across four attributes and eight contestants. These dialogue claims are not historical corrections or assertions about real people.
Proper-name and song-title jokes are adapted: Rousseau/嘍嗦, Kafka/卡夫卡, エンジェルましら/天使猿樂師, マキ/瑪奇, ヤマモト/山本, オレンジ・スター/橘子史達, ゴメンザマス女王/失禮女王. Dedicated editorial review remains required before release.
Preserve 08/05 display markers, all repeated cheers, contestant/item/damage placeholders and original newlines. No music, point allocation, tournament or reward logic is changed.
